caseName: Chafe v. Fla. Dep't of Children & Families
caseNameFull: Renea J. CHAFE v. FLORIDA DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the District Court of Appeals of Florida, Fourth District, dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
